name: Tampere University of Applied Sciences
summary: Large applied-sciences university in Tampere; nine English bachelor's, from software and textile engineering to media and arts and a run-a-real-company degree.

ib.text: In the January joint application TAMK selects by the International UAS Exam, SAT, or a pre-task and interview, not on IB grades. Its engineering rolling admission takes IB with English 5 and HL Maths 5.

dates.label: Rolling admission closes, 15:00, unless places fill first
International UAS Exam, online from 12:00 Finnish time
Results for UAS Exam programmes published

programmes.name: Environmental Engineering and Green Transition
programmes.ib: Rolling admission on IB grades (English 5, HL Maths 5) plus interview; in January, the UAS Exam or SAT.

programmes.name: Software Engineering
programmes.ib: Rolling admission on IB grades (English 5, HL Maths 5) plus interview; in January, the UAS Exam or SAT.

programmes.name: Textile and Material Engineering
programmes.ib: Rolling admission on IB grades (English 5, HL Maths 5) plus interview; in January, the UAS Exam or SAT.

programmes.name: Business in Finland
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam. Finnish language learning is built into the degree.

programmes.name: Team Entrepreneurship
programmes.ib: Pre-task assignment with your application, then an online interview.

programmes.name: Media and Arts
programmes.ib: Pre-task assignment (published 26 November 2026) and an online interview; no English certificate needed.

programmes.name: Early Childhood Education and Care
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam; English at B2. Aimed at non-native Finnish speakers.

programmes.name: Bilingual Degree Programme in Nursing
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam; English at B2. Taught in English and Finnish.

notes: Your IB grades count only in the engineering rolling admission; everywhere else you are chosen by an exam, SAT or pre-task.
Nursing, Early Childhood Education and Business in Finland build Finnish into the degree and are aimed at people who want to work in Finland.
Team Entrepreneurship (Proakatemia) replaces lectures with running a real company with your classmates.
